# Emmbros Autocomp Ltd
> Emmbros Autocomp Ltd is an IATF 16949 certified automotive components manufacturer in Baddi, Himachal Pradesh, India, specializing in high-precision driveline parts, axle shafts, and CNC-machined forged engineering assemblies since 1991.

## Core Capabilities
- Press & Upsetter Forging (up to 2,000 MT)
- High-precision CNC turning, spline cutting & gear hobbing
- Induction hardening & controlled metallurgical heat treatment
- Fully equipped IATF 16949 metallurgical testing laboratory
- OEM Tier-1 supplier to Tata Motors, Ashok Leyland, and global drivetrain manufacturers

## Primary Product Lines
- [Front Axle Shafts](https://emmbros.com/product-application/front-axle-shaft/): Front axle & wheel shafts for heavy and light commercial vehicles.
- [Rear Axle Shafts](https://emmbros.com/product-application/rear-axle-shaft/): Heavy-duty induction hardened rear axle shafts for commercial and agricultural fleets.
- [Gearbox Parts](https://emmbros.com/product-application/gear-box-parts/): Planet carriers, countershafts, main shafts, sprockets, and bull gears.
- [Driveline Parts](https://emmbros.com/product-application/driveline-parts/): Cardan shafts, companion flanges, slip yokes, and universal joint assemblies.
- [Hydraulic Parts](https://emmbros.com/product-application/hydraulic-parts/): Precision brake pistons, hydraulic cylinder rods, and steering components.
- [Planetary Wheel Drives](https://emmbros.com/product-application/planetary-wheel-drive-parts/): Flange hubs, sun gears, and ring gears for construction and earthmoving machinery.

- [About Emmbros](https://emmbros.com/who-we-are/): History, mission, IATF certification, leadership, and plant facilities.
